description: In front of you on the bed is a white plastic chair-like piece with blocky legs, and a small matching white rectangular part lying to its right. The left hand stays planted on the bed to steady the larger piece while the right hand picks up the small part, brings it leftward and inward, and presses it into the circular slot on the upper-right of the larger piece, adjusting and pushing down until it seats in place as the right-hand object.
